## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

While no external parallels are curated in standard reference listings, automated analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive internal Pali text reuse alongside cross-language alignments [DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali corpus, the opening verses (§1.1–3.4) correspond closely with a passage in the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, recurring stock verses in the concluding portion (§3.4/4.1–6.1) are shared with several other apadāna texts, notably the *Ālambaṇadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 223), *Gandhadhūpiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 333), *Naḷamāliyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 473), *Uttiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 30), and *Upavānattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 24) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-linguistic matches, DharmaNexus automatically aligns six segments of the text with the Sanskrit *Kaṭhināvadāna*, showing the strongest alignment at segment §2.4 [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
